# BusinessCollapse.com Full AI Data & Case File Index

## Featured Corporate Collapse Case Files

### 1. WeWork Inc. (WE)
- **Status**: Chapter 11 Reorganization Filed
- **Jurisdiction**: U.S. Bankruptcy Court D.N.J. (Newark, NJ)
- **Peak Valuation**: $47.00 Billion (SoftBank Vision Fund 2019)
- **Liquidation / Restructuring Equity Valuation**: $0.12 OTC
- **Total Debt at Filing**: $18.60 Billion Lease & Debt Liabilities
- **Primary Failure Driver**: Aggressive long-term master lease commitments coupled with short-term flexible desk memberships, unsustainable CAC, and corporate governance failures.
- **Key PACER Motion**: Motion to reject 67 commercial office space leases across New York, London, and San Francisco.

### 2. Spirit Airlines Inc. (SAVE)
- **Status**: Prearranged Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Filing
- **Jurisdiction**: U.S. Bankruptcy Court S.D.N.Y.
- **Peak Valuation**: $4.20 Billion
- **Collapse Debt Load**: $3.30 Billion Total Debt & Aircraft Leases
- **Primary Failure Driver**: Blocked JetBlue merger, Pratt & Whitney GTF engine recall groundings, intense low-cost carrier fare compression, and debt maturity wall.

### 3. Tupperware Brands Corporation (TUPQ)
- **Status**: Chapter 11 Liquidation Petition
- **Jurisdiction**: Wilmington, DE (U.S. Bankruptcy Court D. Del.)
- **Peak Valuation**: $2.60 Billion (2013 Peak)
- **Collapse Liabilities**: $812 Million Senior Secured & Revolving Credit Debt
- **Primary Failure Driver**: Multi-level marketing (MLM) direct sales model failure without e-commerce parity, auditor going-concern warnings, and delayed SEC disclosures.
